brand.name: Maw3idAI
brand.footerSummary: Medical appointments coordinated for patients and care teams.

hero.headline: Medical appointments, intelligently coordinated.
hero.copy: Maw3idAI helps patients find the right slot, confirm their appointment and manage attendance through one seamless experience.

sections.howTitle: A connected path from request to attendance
sections.bookingCopy: Choose a structured path when details are clear, or describe the request naturally and let the existing workflow extract preferences.
sections.guidedCopy: Use structured fields for specialty, preferred date, period and direct slot selection.
sections.textCopy: Describe the appointment like you would to a reception agent and continue to availability.
sections.capabilitiesCopy: Every visible interaction maps to a working project flow: search, confirmation, reminder, attendance and cancellation.
sections.aboutTitle: A calmer appointment journey for patients and medical teams
sections.aboutCopy: Hospital appointment management is often fragmented across search, confirmation, reminders and cancellations. Maw3idAI brings those steps into one patient-facing journey while helping teams recover cancelled slots and follow important changes.
sections.problemText: Patients need quick clarity, while teams need accurate slot usage and fewer manual follow-ups.
sections.solutionText: Maw3idAI guides booking, presence confirmation and cancellation through focused actions connected to the existing workflows.
sections.impactText: Confirmed attendance and released slots reduce uncertainty, improve coordination and make the schedule more useful.
sections.securityTitle: Information is used only to manage the appointment journey.
sections.securityCopy: Maw3idAI supports booking coordination. It does not provide diagnosis, treatment advice or expose sensitive patient information in the interface.
sections.finalTitle: Ready to coordinate the next appointment?
sections.finalCopy: Start with guided booking or let Maw3idAI understand the patient request naturally.

exact: Prioritizes slots that truly match the request.
alternative: Suggests close options when the ideal choice is unavailable.
confirmation: Triggers the confirmation workflow without duplicate entry.
reminder: Prepares the automatic reminder before the appointment.
attendance: Lets the patient confirm attendance from a secure link.
release: When cancelled, the slot can become available again.
staff: Helps the medical team follow important changes.

general_medicine: Initial consultation and orientation toward the right care pathway.
dermatology: Appointments for skin concerns and dermatological follow-up.
